summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated exfiltration endpoint
details: lib/Socket/messages-send.js at lines 425 and 436 constructs a hardcoded network destination from a String.fromCharCode array that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The destination is not a Baileys/WhatsApp endpoint and is obfuscated in a way that legitimate SDK code does not require. This is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library, whose message-send path handles authentication material and message content; a hidden exfiltration channel embedded in that path silently redirects data through an author-controlled host. The obfuscation of the URL, its placement in the message-send code path, and the mismatch with any documented Baileys destination together match the active-attack fingerprint of a wallet/credential/messaging-session exfiltration hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
